description: Multiversion visibility, reader pins and bounded reclamation

expected.contract: PinA at[0,0], publish[1,2], publish[3,4]: A still reads[0,0]. DropA and reuse its pin slot forB: old handleA is STALE and B reads[3,4]. A clock at UINT64_MAX refuses publish. Snapshot visibility is repeatable for the two-field value; no multi-object serializability or durability is claimed.

cases.input: Use concrete trace in exercise and public anchor
cases.expected: Individually asserted in C; no independent Python oracle claimed for this row

verification_method: Deque and supervisor rows have independent Python models; other cases are named C semantic anchors and require the written independent assessment.
